lines.v1: Oh, there once was a ship as long as a town,
lines.v2: Her propellers could spin the whole way round.
lines.v3: No rudder to steer, and no tug to tow,
lines.v4: Just you on the bridge, and the pods below!
lines.c1: Haul away, bring her in slow,
lines.c2: Point the pods where you want to go!
lines.c3: Azipod Bridge, come take the wheel,
lines.c4: And bring her in on an even keel!
lines.w1: It's a real sea chart into Biscayne Bay,
lines.w2: Cut the corner, and aground she'll stay!
lines.w3: Watch from the bridge, or the wing up high,
lines.w4: At sunset, or under a starry sky.
lines.t1: Free on your phone, so come set sail!
